description:
Launch a coin on Main and it is a pump.fun coin. If the name is new, your coin launches against SOL and it is the main for that name.

If the name is taken, your coin launches paired with the main. It is priced in the main, so buying it with SOL buys the main first, in the same transaction. The copy's liquidity sits in the main.

A copy can still launch, trade and run, at no extra charge. What it cannot do is drain the coin it copied, because every buy of it is a buy of the main.
